summary.text: Lois Kolkhorst is a Republican member of the Texas State Senate who has represented District 18 since December 2014 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. She previously served in the Texas House of Representatives from 2001 to 2015 and owns Kolkhorst Petroleum.

paragraphs.text: Kolkhorst is the owner and operator of Kolkhorst Petroleum, according to Ballotpedia.

She previously was chief executive officer of the Washington County Chamber of Commerce/Economic Development Foundation of Brenham from 1995 to 2000, and director of marketing for the athletics administration of Texas Christian University from 1988 to 1996.
Kolkhorst represented District 13 in the Texas House of Representatives from 2001 to 2015, and she assumed office in the State Senate on December 22, 2014, succeeding Glenn Hegar.

In 2023-2024 she chaired the Health & Human Services Committee and was also assigned to the Business & Commerce, Finance, Natural Resources and Economic Development, and Water, Agriculture, & Rural Affairs committees.
She advanced from the Republican primary on March 3, 2026.
